prompt:
REFERENCES
@image1 — Michelle, 63: face, hair and build only.
@image2 — the bedroom: copy it — the white vanity and oval mirror right of centre, the lilac stool, the curtained window on the right, the cream bed on the left.
@audio1 — Michelle's voice.

SHOT: A quiet animated drama: at night at her vanity Michelle stops recognising the woman in the mirror and buries her under layer after layer of foundation; one take of 6 shots, 9:16, 24 s.

TIMELINE
[0–4s] Shot 1 · medium, slow creep in: Frame 1: Michelle seated on the stool at the vanity, back to camera, her face in the oval mirror, the bulbs on above it — she leans an inch toward the mirror; the camera creeps in behind her.
[4–8s] Shot 2 · close-up, slow push-in: her fingertip touches under her eye and drops; the camera pushes in. A beat of stillness first. Michelle says: "When did I start looking like this? Tired. Worn out."
[8–12s] Shot 3 · medium close-up, slow tilt: her hand drops from her face to the vanity; the camera tilts with it. Michelle says: "Older than I am. No wonder he stopped looking at me."
[12–16s] Shot 4 · insert, slow tilt: her hand turns the frame over and lays it flat; the camera tilts with it.
[16–21s] Shot 5 · medium close-up, the camera orbits: her fingers press the foundation on three times; the camera orbits slowly round to her front.
[21–24s] Shot 6 · medium, handheld, breathing: her eyes drop away from the mirror; the camera breathes. Last frame: Michelle on the stool at the vanity, face heavy with foundation, looking down away from the mirror.

LOOK: A theatrical 3D animated feature, stylised adults with large expressive eyes, soft skin, sculpted hair, fabric with weight; natural, ungraded colour; light from the vanity bulbs over the oval mirror, a shadow side on every face. Michelle: a faded grey cotton bathrobe tied over a pale nightgown, grey felt slippers.

SOUND: Dialogue in natural American English — Michelle's voice from @audio1; only the person written as speaking speaks, and on every other shot nobody speaks. No music. The actions' own sounds: jars and bottles touched down on the vanity, a sponge patting skin, her slow breath; a still bedroom under it.

KEEP: same faces, hair and clothes in every frame; just Michelle in the scene; text, logos and captions nowhere; five fingers on each hand; real weight and timing; eyes off the lens
